name: Gearing Redridge
summary: At Lakeshire, a besieged garrison needs sturdy copper equipment from Ironforge. Tormus Deepforge asks aspiring Alliance smiths to forge the gear and help resident smith Verner Osgood defend the region from hostile orcs and gnolls.

sections.title: A Plea Across Kingdoms
sections.body: At Ironforge's Great Forge, dwarven smiths know the Alliance's frontline struggles reach beyond Dun Morogh. In the Redridge Mountains, Lakeshire faces repeated attacks from Blackrock orcs marching from Stonewatch Keep and gnolls roaming the northern ridges. Royal reinforcements from Stormwind are slow to arrive, and local supplies remain dangerously low.

sections.title: The Anvils of Lakeshire
sections.body: Lakeshire's resident blacksmith, Verner Osgood, works nearly alone at his outdoor forge, mending shattered armor and replacing broken weapons. Seeing the strain on his human counterpart, Tormus Deepforge asks developing smiths to bring four Runed Copper Belts and four Heavy Copper Mauls to Lakeshire. In return for bolstering the militia's defensive reserves, Verner teaches traveling craftsmen finer trade techniques.

faq.q: Who starts the Gearing Redridge quest?
faq.answer: Tormus Deepforge, a dwarven smith at Ironforge's Great Forge, offers this work to Alliance smiths with adequate skill in their trade.

faq.q: Why does Lakeshire need weapons and armor from Ironforge?
faq.answer: Lakeshire faces constant attacks from Blackrock orcs occupying Stonewatch Keep and aggressive gnolls in the northern ridges. Its solitary smith, Verner Osgood, is overwhelmed mending arms and armor for the militia on his own.

faq.q: Who receives the shipment in Redridge?
aliases: where to turn in gearing redridge
faq.answer: Verner Osgood, Lakeshire's local blacksmith, receives the shipment near the forge in the lakeside town.

faq.q: What equipment must be forged for the task?
faq.answer: You need to make four Runed Copper Belts and four Heavy Copper Mauls. Together, they show skill in protective plating and heavy striking craftsmanship.

faq.q: What threats are troubling Redridge at this time?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs hold Stonewatch Keep, while violent gnoll packs prowl the northern foothills around Lakeshire.

faq.q: What reward does Verner Osgood offer in return?
faq.answer: Freed from the frantic burden of outfitting every guardsman from scratch, Verner teaches you finer blacksmithing techniques.

angles.text: As a blacksmith, you prove you can make durable weapons and protective armor in quantity for an active warfront.
As an Alliance member, you carry aid from Ironforge to the beleaguered human townships of the south, where Stormwind's divided leadership has been slow to act.
As a dwarf, you draw on a craft that forms the backbone of the Alliance war effort, and Tormus directs Ironforge's finest smiths to aid their beleaguered allies.
As a human of the southern kingdoms, you receive metalwork forged in Khaz Modan, relief against the aggressive Blackrock remnants.
